tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// klu dbang rgyal po'i char 'bebs byin rlabs dpal ster zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po'i sgo nas char dbab par 'dod na/ thog mar klu'i thebs dang 'byung khams chu nang 'phrad sogs gza' skar legs pa'i nyin/ rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbrar ldan pas yi dam gang rung gi sgo nas bum pa bsgrub thub na legs shing stabs ma 'grigs tshe rten khrus bzang pos yul de'i gzhi bdag dang chu mig gi gtsos 'dzam gling yongs la dmigs te sbyang ba dang khrus gsol legs par bya/ cha gsum dang gzhi bdag gtor ma dbul/ rang ngam grogs gang rigs dam tshig gtsang mas lha bsang gtong*/ 'phags pa sprin chen po'i mdo/ spang skong*/ gser 'od/ klu 'bum rnams sgrogs/ bla ma dkon mchog dang yi dam la gsol ba drag tu gdab/ sems can gyi sdug bsngal de dag la phan pa'i bsam pa yang yang bya/ phan thub mi thub snyam pa'i the tshom mi 'tshal/ phan par thag gcad/ chu mig gi steng ngam nye 'gram bla gab med pa'i phyogs gang bder zangs sam ma 'byor tshe shing gi rkang gsum gyi khar maṇḍal li rag 'khar ba ma yin pa'i steng du nas 'bras gang rung gi tshom bu lnga dgod/ mthar mtshams 'dzin me tog dang chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rgyas par bsham/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis sbags pa'i gtor ma/ klu dbang rgyal por lcog zlum gcig rang gang mos kyi chos skyong la gcig klu la gcig gzhi bdag la gcig zan ril/ phye mar/ ba dmar mo'i 'o ma dang sbyar ba'i klu sman/ dar sna tshogs kyi ba dan sogs ji ltar dgos pa dang*/ dar sngon po'am ljang gu'i gdugs dang lda ldis mdzes par byas la/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/

zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gande āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyā āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ zhes so so'i phyag rgyar bcas dang*/ oṃ badzra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe tra pra tsa li ni/ pradzñā pā ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we/ badzra sa twa hṛ da ya santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swā hā/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas byin dbab/ de nas bdag bskyed ni/ skyabs 'gro spyi ltar ci nus dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po bsgom bzlas zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang nyid skad cig gis sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs kar pad zla la gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs/ na mo nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā re bhyaḥzhes phyag bya/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum gyis rgyud dag par byas la/ tshogs zhing rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas klu rnams dang sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog ind+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ mgrin pa yan chad dkar po gtsug tor dang bcas shing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ sham thabs dang chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun gyen du phyogs pa'i chun po'i rgyab yol mnga' zhing sbrul mjug rnams gdan du bting ba/ de'i mdun du sgrib sel dkar po g.yas rin po che'i myu gu dang*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas su byams pa dmar po rin po ches mtshan pa'i klu shing gi me tog dang*/ g.yon ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu 'jam dpal gzhon nu ser po utpa la'i steng na gnas pa'i ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad dkar 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu blta zhing pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de dag gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams thams cad du dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ 'og tu klu'i tshogs thams cad kyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che thogs te gdong gyen du blta ba'o// spro na/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad klu dbang gi rgyal po gtso 'khor lnga'i rnam par oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ rang gi thugs kar pad zla'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng g.yas skor du 'khor ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas klus gtso byas pa'i sems can thams cad ngan 'gro'i skye gnas las thar bar mdzad/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs rje dang byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus nas rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa la thim pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra adhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ thun las ldang bar 'dod na thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi klu dang sa bdag gi nyer 'tshe la sogs pa las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas 'khor dang gdan 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsam/ de nas mdun gyi chu mig gi maṇḍa lar dmigs te/ a mṛ tes bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du chu mig de nyid rgya mtsho chen po ltar dkar zhing dwangs la lbu ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa/ mdun du rin po che'i gter dang srog chags du ma gnas pa/ phyi rol du gangs ri dang spang ris khor yug tu bskor zhing*/

ljon shing dang me tog sna tshogs bkra ba/ 'dab chags sna tshogs skad snyan par sgrogs shing*/ glang po dang ri dwags sna tshogs pa rtse zhing bag phebs pa/ de lta bu'i mtsho'i dbus su pam̐ las padma 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ sngon po de las 'od zer 'phros pas klu rnams dang sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po sku mdog ind+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ mgrin pa yan chad dkar po gtsug tor dang bcas shing 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ sham thabs dang chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ kha dog sna tshogs pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun gyen du phyogs pa'i chun po'i rgyab yol mnga' zhing sbrul mjug rnams gdan du bting ba/ de'i mdun du sgrib sel dkar po g.yas rin po che'i myu gu dang*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yas su byams pa dmar po rin po ches mtshan pa'i klu shing gi me tog dang*/ g.yon ril pa spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu 'jam dpal gzhon nu ser po utpa la'i steng na gnas pa'i ral gri dang glegs bam 'dzin pa/ g.yon du spyan ras gzigs dkar po pad dkar 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ bcom ldan 'das la rtse gcig tu blta zhing pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de dag gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams thams cad du dgra bcom pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ gtso bo'i mdun du chu bdag wa ru ṇa dkar po/ shar du mtha' yas dkar po/ lhor 'jog po dmar po/ nub tu stobs kyi rgyu nag po/ byang du rigs ldan dkar po/ mer nor rgyas ser po/

bden bral du dung skyong ser po/ rlung du padma dmar po/ dbang ldan du chu lha dkar po/ de rnams kyi mdun du gtsug na rin chen ljang gu ste thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ stod lha'i lus can thal mo sbyar ba/ kha dog dag pa'i chu shel ltar dwangs shing yul gyi dbang por sna tshogs su snang ba/ spyi gtsug na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang bcas pa'i sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan pa/ smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyogs g.yon nas rang 'dra'i chung mas brten pa'o// steng du sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha'i tshogs dang*/ mtha' skor du sa bdag klu gnyan yul lha gzhi bdag snang zhing srid pa'i dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad sprin phung 'thibs pa ltar bzhugs shing 'khod par gyur/ lha thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas klu dbang gi rgyal po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha gter bdag gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang a ka ru dang spos dkar rgya shug sogs bsregs shing ting ting shags dkrol/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yang dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol// chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso// btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing*// nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che// dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi// zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa// dul zhing bsam gtan sa la bzhugs// chos dang ye shes chags bral ba// kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan// tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha// thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen// shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni// mchod pas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu// 'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang*// nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang*// mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol// zhes dang*/

oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbha ga wān e hye hi mahā kā ru ṇi ka dṛ shya to sa ma ya st+waṃ zhes pas spyan drangs nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das// tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swā hās mchod yon dbul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// oṃ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ zhes pas gdan phul la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes yang yang brjod pas mdun bskyed la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo la rdo rje sems dpa' dang 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/

slar yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas ri rab chen po'i zom dang rgya mtsho chen po'i klong nas klu'i rgyal po rnams la snang zhing srid pa'i sde brgyad kyi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ri rab chen po'i steng shod dang*// rgya mtsho chen po'i kha zhabs dang*// 'dzam bu gling gi dbus mtha' dang*// srid pa'i rlan la gnas pa yi// sa bdag klu gnyan 'khor bcas kun// gnas 'dir de ring spyan 'dren na// phyag na rdo rje'i dam tshig dang*// klu dbang rgyal po'i thugs rje yis// gnas 'dir myur du gshegs su gsol// oṃ e hye hi ma hā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi tshogs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la// bdag gis pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal mo sbyar nas khyed la gsol 'debs kyi// gsan nas phan gdags slad du 'dir gshegs shig /oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra e hye his spyan drangs/ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ gyis gdan dbul/ oṃ ma hā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā sogs kyis mchod la/ zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pa'i sgo nas phyogs mtshams khor yug kun tu 'khod par bsam/ mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/ ༈ a mṛ tes bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/

mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ arghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ pā dyaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra paṣpe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra nai wi dyā āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ zhes so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ thal mo sbyar nas/ rab 'byams rgya mtsho dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gi gus pas bshams pa 'di// ji snyed rgyal ba sras dang bcas// de snyed rnams la bdag 'bul na// thugs rje mnga' ba khyed rnams kyis// ci bde bar ni bzhes nas kyang*// sems can don kun mdzad du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes pas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du tshigs bcad dang sngags gong 'og thams cad 'dra bar byas la/ zhabs bsil dang pā dyaṃ/ me tog dang puṣpe/ bdug spos dang dhū pe/ snang gsal dang ā lo ke /dri mchog dang gandhe/ zhal zas dang nai wi dyā/ rol mo dang shabda sbyar zhing so so'i phyag rgya dang*/ badzra dharmā ra ṇi sogs rol mo dang bcas te dbul lo// de nas oṃ las rin po che sna bdun sprul te/ oṃ sarba bitpū ra pū ra su ra su ra/ ā brta ya ā brta ya hoḥzhes brjod cing*/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsakra ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la// nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas// bkren cing phongs pa rgyun bcad de// 'byor ba phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma ṇi ratna pū dzi te hūm̐/ zhes pa 'gre/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas// ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de// shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas// thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog

/wasti ratna/ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas// phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan// bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing*// yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hā ta ratna/ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas// lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas// bla med theg pa rab zhon te// thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti ratna/ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul bas// srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te// rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas// sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /tu raṃ ga dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas// nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas// phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de// snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /khaḍga ratna/ zhes brjod cing dbul/ de nas 'dod yon lnga dbul te/ kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan// phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa// mos blos mchod gnas rnams la bdag 'bul gyi /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i// yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams// mos blos= bzhes shig= shabda= phyogs dus kun na tsandan sbrul snying dang*// a gar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams// mos blos= bzhes shig= gandhe= phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i// lus sems rtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams// mos blos= bzhes shig= rā sa= phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khril chags pa'i// reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams// mos blos= bzhes shig= sparshe= zhes pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes srid gsum kun khyab cing*// nyin byed bye ba'i gzi brjid 'phrog byed pa'i// rgyal sras tshogs kyis mchog tu rab bstod pa// rgyal po'i dbang po mchog la gus phyag 'tshal// nyi ma'i drung du zla bas bgrod pa bzhin// dgra ngan dpung tshogs ma lus zil gyis gnon// rgya mtsho'i klong nas klu mchog ma lus pa// gus pa'i tshul gyis thal sbyar rab tu btud// ind+ra nī la'i mdangs ldan gzi brjid 'bar// thun mtshams sprin gyi mdog can bla gos 'dzin// chos sgrogs phyag rgya mi phyed thugs kar 'chings// rab mdzes gtsug na sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka can// sngo bsangs nam mkha'i mdog can 'dab brgya pa// zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa'i dbus na mdzes// ku mud mdangs ldan sgrib pa rnam sel ba// rin chen myu gu yid 'ong bum pa 'dzin// dmar ba'i mdog can mi pham byams pa yis// klu shing me tog ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin// 'jam dpal gser mdog rab tu 'bar ba can// glegs bam ral gri yongs su 'dzin par mdzod// thugs rje chen pos dmar 'od me tog 'dzin// 'khor tshogs dpag med dbus na mngon mtho ba// mtha' yas zhing khams dpag med 'od zer 'gyed// tshul bzang yongs su rdzogs pa'i klu dbang la// gus pas bstod pa'i dge tshogs gang thob pas// dus gsum pha ma dang bcas 'gro ba rnams// rnam mkhyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog

/ces rong ston chen po shes bya kun rig gis mdzad pas mtshon rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pas bstod pa'i mjug tu/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// mchod do// skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan mang du brjod pa'i mthar/ yul khams 'dis gtso byas 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su rgyun mi chad par 'bab cing*/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ sad dang ser ba btsa' than sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bkra shis pa dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rgyun mi chad par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos te gong ltar byin gyis brlab/ oṃ ma hā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra re re nas mgor sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzu 'phrul stobs dang mngon par shes pa'i dpal// nye bar dgongs te thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba// rdo rje'i chos srung rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod la/ klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas yul khams 'dis gtso byas 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus su rgyun mi chad par 'bab cing*/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ sad dang ser ba btsa' than sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bkra shis pa dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rgyun mi chad par mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol/ gtor ma dang po klu dbang rgyal po la dbul te/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gtor ma lha'i bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis brlab/ tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā zhes pa la/ oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan lnga'am bdun gyis dbul/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swa hā nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ngo bo nyid// sgrub la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas yul khams 'dis gtso byas 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus du rgyun mi chad par 'bab cing*/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ sad dang ser ba btsa' than sogs bar du bcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bkra shis pa dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rgyun mi chad par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gnyis pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin rlabs dran par byas la/ rang gi sgos kyi chos skyong rnams la phul ba'am/ 'jig rten skyong ba rnams la dmigs te/ oṃ sarba lo ka kā ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog ces pa'i bar dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba chen po rnams kyis yul khams 'dis gtso byas 'jig rten gyi khams su char chu dus rgyun mi chad par 'bab cing*/ lo phyugs rtag tu legs pa dang*/ sad dang ser ba btsa' than sogs bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bkra shis pa dang bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rgyun mi chad par mdzad du gsol/ gtor ma gsum pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang*/ lag g.yon khu tshur bcangs te mthe bong bsgreng ba'i steng g.yas pa'i thal mos gdugs ltar bkab cing se gol gtogs pa dang bcas klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/

oṃ hi li hi li ma hā hi li phrum̐ phu swā hā/ zhes lan gsum dang*/ oṃ bhakṣa ya bhakṣa ya sa ma ya t-iṣṭha dzrum̐ phrum̐ phu hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lan gsum la sogs pas klu rnams la phul ba'i mthar/ gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis klu'i rgyal po chen po brgyad kyis gtso byas/ klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad dang*/ khyad par du'ang yul phyogs 'dir gnod cing lan chags pa'i sha mkhon don du gnyer pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad la sbyin no// tshim zhing mnyes nas gnod pa dang gdug rtsub rnams zhi ba dang*/ phan pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la brtse bar dgongs nas yul phyogs 'dis mtshon te rgyal khams kun tu lo legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i mthun rkyen char gyi rgyun rab tu 'bebs pa'i phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las gzhol/ gtor ma bzhi pa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang*/ lag g.yas lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥs gzhi bdag rnams dgug oṃ bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis dbul/ gzhi bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas pas yul khams 'dis mtshon te rgyal khams kun tu lo legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i mthun rkyen char gyi rgyun rab tu 'bebs pa'i phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las gzhol/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ gzungs thag rdo rje maṇḍal steng gi shar ngos su bzhag pa nas bzung ste/ thog mar dkon mchog gsum la mos gus drag pos gsol ba yang yang gdab/ mkha' khyab rigs drug gi sems can thams cad la snying rje drag po yang yang bsgom/ khyad par sa bdag klu gnyan yul lha gzhi bdag mi dang mi ma yin pa rnams la byams pa dang snying rje drag po yang yang btang nas/

rang nyid klu'i dbang phyug rgyal por gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig baiḍūrya ltar gsal ba las 'od zer dkar po zla ba shar ba ltar 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad khyab/ rang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag 'od zer ba spu'i bu ga nas phyir 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi sangs rgyas klu dbang rgyal po la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig baiḍūrya ltar gsal ba las 'od zer dkar po zla ba shar ba ltar 'phros/ mtha' skor gyi phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa nyan thos chos srung nor lha rnams la phog de rnams kyi thugs kar thim zhing mnyes par bsam/ slar yang de dag las 'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can 'phros/ klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas pa la phog de rnams kyis tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ khyad par so so'i lus kyi yan lag dang nying lag stobs dang gzi brjid bkrag mdangs nyams pa dang*/ 'khor dang longs spyod nyams pa thams cad gsos/ nad dang duḥkha zhi zhing bde ba dang ldan par bsam/ yang 'od zer 'phros te rigs drug gi sems can thams cad dang khyad par ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar bsam/ yang 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa steng gi bar snang du sprin ltar 'thibs pa las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs te skom pa'i sdug bsngal thams cad bsal bar bsam/ yang sprin gyi gseb nas rin po che'i rgyan dang gos dang zas nor longs spyod ji ltar 'dod pa babs/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul phongs zhi bar byas/ khyad par lha klu 'byung po rnams la rang rang gang 'dod pa'i zas gos rgyan dang longs spyod pho brang skyed mos tshal/ nor phyugs 'khor g.yog sogs zad mi shes pa'i dpal thob pas thams cad dga' zhing mgu nas byams pa'i sems rnyed de phan tshun pha ma lta bu'i 'du shes skyes par bsam/ yang chos kyi sgra dbyangs bsgrags pas thams cad kyis byang chub tu sems bskyed/

sems can la phan bde dpag tu med par bsgrub par bsam/ yang klu'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'od kyis klu rgyal rnams bskul te/ de rnams kyis dregs pa sde brgyad rnams bskul/ de dag gi kha dang*/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka dang*/ ba spu'i khung bu rnams nas kyang kha rlangs kyi rnam pas nam mkha' la sprin phung 'khrigs shing 'brug gi sgra dbyangs sgrogs pa dang*/ glog 'od 'khyug cing yul phyogs thams cad du char drag po dpag tu med pa rgyun mi chad par 'bebs par bsam/ skabs skabs su ci'ang mi dmigs par snang grags rig gsum rang gi sems kyi yo long du shes par bya/ skabs skabs su rang dang mdun gyi klu dbang rgyal po'i sku dang rgyan dang 'khor dang bcas pa la sems gtad nas/ tadya thā/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te swā hā/ zhes gtso bor bzlas mthar/ sarba nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā re bhiḥwarṣa ā be sha ya ā be sha ya swā hā/ zhes pa'ang sbrel te tha mal gyi gtam dang ma 'dres par sngags bgrang*/ thun ring thung skabs dang sbyar/ thun bsdu ran pa dang mchod pa kha gsos la gong ltar bsang sbyangs byin gyis brlab/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nā gend+ra sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/ shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes srid gsum kun khyab cing*// nyin byed bye ba'i gzi brjid 'phrog byed pa'i// rgyal sras tshogs kyis mchog tu rab bstod pa// rgyal po'i dbang po mchog la gus phyag 'tshal// zhes sam tshang bas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das klu'i dbang phyug rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi klu gnyan sa bdag gi nyer 'tshe la sogs pa/ las ngan sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ klu la'ang*/ oṃ ma hā nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā nas/

shabda'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ gdengs ka nor bu 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ni// sa 'og mun pa'i tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa// bstan la rab dga' mthu stobs bsam mi khyab// klu rgyal 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes bstod/ klu'i rgyal po brgyad kyis gtsor byas pa'i klu gnyan sa bdag gi rigs thams cad kyis/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' dang*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la brtse bar dgongs nas yul phyogs 'dis mtshon te rgyal khams thams cad du lo legs phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i mthun rkyen char gyi rgyun rab tu 'bebs pa'i phrin las dang sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las gzhol/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ/ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badzra muḥzhes dang*/ mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gang lhags pa'i// 'byung po sa 'og rgyu ba dang*// gang yang sa steng 'khod pa dang*// sa blar rgyu ba gang yin pa// mgu bar gyis la rang gnas su// thams cad thams cad 'gro bar gyis// oṃ ma hā nā ga rā dza sarba bhū mi ba ti gatstsha zhes pas ye shes pa rnams gshegs/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la thim/ 'jig rten pa rnams kyang rang rang gi gnas su song bar bsams la/ rang gi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po zhes brjod cing gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /klu dbang rgyal po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog

/byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skye 'gyur zhing*// skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang*// 'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba// dge legs thams cad 'byung ba yi// yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces bsngo smon dang*/ ston mchog dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// sangs rgyas phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /zhi ba chags bral lha mis mchod 'os pa// chos la phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /tshogs kyi dam pa lha mis mchod 'os pa// dge 'dun phyag 'tshal deng 'dir bde legs shog /sems can gang dag 'gro dang mi 'gro ba// de dag thams cad deng 'dir bde legs shog /ces sogs bkra shis ci rigs brjod/ thun bar du brgya rtsa dang chu sbyin gang mang gtong*/ klu thebs dang bstun pa'i klu gtor yang gtong ngo*// de lta bu'i tshul gyis nyin re la thun gsum rer zhag gsum nas bdun gyi bar nyams su blang*/ cho ga grub nas tshom bu dang gtor ma sogs chu mig gam rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du gshegs/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o// de ltar bgyis pas rang gi nad gdon zhi zhing tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa dang*/ bstan 'gror phan bde bla na med pa 'byung bar gdon mi za'o// de ltar klu dbang rgyal po yi// mdo rgyud snying po rgya gzhung don// 'khrul zad gong ma'i dgongs bzhed bzhin// char 'bebs byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i gter// snyigs dus skye 'gro la phan phyir// dkon mchog rgyal mtshan bzhed don ltar// dge slong dpal ldan chos skyong des// lhun grub steng gi chos grwar sbyar/

'di la ma phyir mchan dkyus su shor ba sogs dag min sna tshogs 'dug pa so so'i khungs dang bstun nas zhu dag cung zad bgyis shing ngag 'don bklag chog tu 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa 'ji ga rten gyi khams su dge legs rgya chen po dus rtag tu 'byung ba'i rgyur gyur cig sarba dā kalyā ṇaṃ bha ba tu// ༈ /gong gi dkyus kyi char dbab pa'i sngags sham ni mkhan chen dpal chos pa nyid kyi tshig bsgrigs las ji ltar byung ba bzhin bris pa yin la/ rgya gzhung gi mchan bu yig rnying las/ sngags ni klu dang sangs rgyas kyi sngags la ba ri sha ya pa ri sha ya pa ta ya pa ta ya zhes gdags so// zhes 'byung ba ltar na/ tadya thā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga to bha ga wān nā ga rā dze shwa ra a dhiṣṭhā na a dhiṣṭhi te ba ri sha ya ba ri sha ya pa ta ya pa ta ya swā hā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ sarba nā ga rā dza sa pa ri wā ri bhiḥb ri sha ya ba ri sha ya pa ta ya pa ta ya swā hā/ zhes bzla'o// //sarba dā shu bhaṃ bhu yāt// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
